concerns.text: Task T050 is marked as unimplemented (`- [ ]`) in 'Phase N+1', yet the spec's Edge Cases and FR-002 mandate handling participants with <3 valid days to prevent model failure. Deferring this mandatory constraint to a future phase violates the requirement that the system MUST handle these cases.

Task T052 (fail loudly on corrupted data) is unimplemented (`- [ ]`) in 'Phase N+1'. FR-001 and the Edge Cases section explicitly require the pipeline to fail gracefully with clear error messages rather than crashing or fabricating data. Leaving this as optional violates the data integrity constraint.

Task T028b only flags the LOPO consistency result if <90% but does not enforce the threshold or halt the pipeline. FR-005 requires the system to 'verify' this consistency. Without a task to enforce this check (e.g., raising an error or blocking report generation), the success criterion is not functionally preserved.

Task T029 returns a boolean `pvalue_consistent` flag but does not explicitly store the actual p-value of the sensitivity model in `model_results.json`. FR-006 requires verifying the p-value remains <0.05 (or consistent). Without storing the value, the verification cannot be independently audited from the final artifact, violating the Single Source of Truth principle.

Task T031c explicitly states 'Do NOT assert or fail the build' and only returns a pass flag. FR-008 requires reporting whether consistency is >=80%. If the task does not integrate this flag into the final report generation (T032) or the schema (T005b), the requirement to 'report' the result is not preserved in the deliverable.

Task T023 generates diagnostic plots but does not mandate writing the statistical test results (Shapiro-Wilk, Breusch-Pagan p-values) to `model_results.json`. SC-004 and Constitution Principle VII require these diagnostics to be measured and reported. The absence of a task to persist these values makes the success criterion unmeasurable.
